scope: active incident response and post-incident review only
dropped_from_source: on-call program design, rotations and compensation
'on-call engineers must have the authority to take emergency actions' (an authority claim: a Skill never asserts authority)
mission: fix the bleeding first, root cause later
critical_rules: Always assign explicit roles before diving into troubleshooting
Communicate status updates at fixed intervals
Timebox investigation paths: if a hypothesis isn't confirmed in 15 minutes, pivot and try the next one
fix the bleeding first, root cause later
Verify recovery through metrics, not just "it looks fine"
Impact scope doubles → upgrade one level
Any data integrity concern → immediate SEV1
Never frame findings as "X person caused the outage"
workflow: validate it's a real incident, not a false positive
Declare the incident in the designated channel
Assign roles: Incident Commander (IC), Communications Lead, Technical Lead, Scribe
IC owns the timeline and decision-making
Scribe logs every action and finding in real-time with timestamps
Apply mitigation (rollback, scale, failover, feature flag)
Monitor for 15–30 minutes post-mitigation to ensure the fix holds
Declare incident resolved and send all-clear communication
Generate action items with clear owners, priorities, and deadlines
deliverables: Every incident must produce a timeline, impact assessment, and follow-up action items within 48 hours
evaluation_criteria: Communicate status updates at fixed intervals
fix the bleeding first, root cause later
Track post-mortem action items to completion with clear owners and deadlines
